answer_1.quote: automatically generating medical reports can assist radiologists in clinical decision-making and emerge as a prominent attractive research direction in both artificial intelligence and clinical medicine.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the widely-used BLEU, METEOR and ROUGE-L, which are reported by the evaluation toolkit, to test the performance.

answer_4.quote: we invite two professional clinicians to evaluate the perceptual quality of 100 randomly selected reports generated by "Baselines" and "Baselines w/ CMCL".
answer_4.guideline: The clinicians are unaware of which model generates these reports... we check the agreements between them.
